title: Fix Grid & List view toggle in My Files section

requirements.text: Fix the Grid & List view toggle in the 'My Files' (Dashboard/FileList) section so that clicking the grid or list view icon in the FileToolbar actually switches the file display area between grid layout and list layout. The viewMode state must be correctly initialized, passed down from the parent (Dashboard or FileList), and consumed by the file rendering logic to apply the correct layout.

quotes: clicking on the 'Grid & View' icon does not cause it to change in the file display area

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking the grid view icon in the FileToolbar switches the file display area to a multi-column grid layout.
Clicking the list view icon in the FileToolbar switches the file display area to a single-column list layout.
The active/selected view icon is visually highlighted to indicate the current view mode.
The view mode state persists correctly within the session (does not reset unexpectedly on re-render).
The toggle works consistently in the My Files (Dashboard) section.

constraints: Do not modify any files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui.
Do not alter existing backend logic or data models.
nonGoals: Adding new view modes beyond grid and list.
Persisting the selected view mode to the backend or localStorage.
Changing the view toggle behavior in any section other than My Files (Dashboard).
